snippet.title: Babylon 5: Armada II - An Old-School Star Trek Armada II Sci-Fi Total Conversion!
snippet.description:
Babylon 5: Armada II - An Old-School Star Trek Armada II Sci-Fi Total Conversion!

Babylon 5 is a sci-fi IP that, for many, didn't get as much love as it deserved - happily batting with some of the most iconic sci-fi out there like Star Trek and Battlestar Galactica. Fitting, then, that Star Trek Armada II should get the total conversion treatment and see the forces of the Earth Alliance battling Shadows, Minbari, and more to achieve victory.

ModDB: https://www.moddb.com/mods/babylon-5-armada-ii
